Public opinion polls offer valuable, though sometimes limited, insights into voter preferences during election campaigns. Drawing on March 2024 survey data from YouGov, which includes responses from 1,559 U.S. adults, we estimate the share of votes Joe Biden is likely to receive in the upcoming November election.
